nodes.description: Public address state variable holding the privileged owner address of the UniswapV3LessGas contract.
Constructor that initializes the owner state variable with the deploying caller (msg.sender).
External function guarded by require(msg.sender == owner) that performs an arbitrary ERC20 transferFrom through the supplied token contract.
Caller-controlled address read in the constructor (owner initialization) and in the access-control require inside transferUniswapV3LessGas.
External call _token.transferFrom(_sender, _receiver, _amount) to a caller-supplied contract; return value is forwarded directly.
Function parameter _token: caller-supplied ERC20 token contract whose transferFrom is invoked.
Function parameter _sender: address the tokens are pulled from.
Function parameter _receiver: address the tokens are sent to.
Function parameter _amount: amount of tokens transferred.

edges.reason: The untrusted caller address msg.sender flows into the owner state variable during construction, establishing the privileged role.
The constructor writes the owner state variable, defining the access-control authority of the contract.
msg.sender is read inside the require statement of transferUniswapV3LessGas, gating entry to the function.
The owner state variable is compared against msg.sender in the access-control require, controlling function execution.
Execution of transferUniswapV3LessGas triggers the external call to _token.transferFrom, handing control to a caller-supplied contract.
The caller-supplied _token parameter is used as the target of the external transferFrom call.
The _sender parameter is passed as the 'from' argument of the external transferFrom call.
The _receiver parameter is passed as the 'to' argument of the external transferFrom call.
The _amount parameter is passed as the value argument of the external transferFrom call, where token accounting arithmetic is applied.

normalization_plan.reason: _token is only used as the target contract of the external transferFrom call, so it is normalized into that unsafe_operation node.
_sender only supplies the 'from' argument to transferFrom and can be folded into the unsafe_operation node.
_receiver only supplies the 'to' argument to transferFrom and can be folded into the unsafe_operation node.
_amount only supplies the value argument to transferFrom and can be folded into the unsafe_operation node.
